visualCharacteristics.purpose: Coverflow slider with an enlarged center slide and smaller neighbours, each slide a circular illustration, title and description
visualCharacteristics.navigation: prev/next arrows, dot pagination, swipe, keyboard arrows, click a neighbour to bring it to center

contentPattern.structure: slide image | title heading, description, optional CTA

reuseGuidance: Use for 3+ product/solution slides where a centered highlight is wanted. For full-width slides use carousel.
